text:
Alice CS: Heads up - FinTrust just escalated. They say the model started fabricating regulatory citations and audit dates after last week's variant swap. :warning:
Ken (FinTrust): Example from their transcript: 'According to the SEC filing 10-K-2021, FinTrust restated earnings on 2019-05-01.' This is not true for us.
Maya Support: Can you paste the exact prompt + response and any request_id? Also which endpoint/model version were you hitting?
Ken (FinTrust): Here — we hit /v1/chat with model v2-int8-fastpath (they referenced the timestamp around 2024-11-04). Request ID: r-5f8a2c9. Prompt and response below:
```
User: "Summarize FinTrust's regulatory history and any material restatements."
Model: "Per SEC filing 10-K-2021, FinTrust filed a restatement on 2019-05-01 related to revenue recognition. See section 4.2 of the filing."
```
Ken (FinTrust): We checked SEC and there is no 10-K-2021 listing a restatement for FinTrust. The model is inventing filing IDs and section refs.
Raj Eng: Acknowledged. We rolled v2-int8-fastpath last week which enabled prefix pruning + quantized kernels for faster response. Not aware of changes to the knowledge base.
deploy-bot: Deployment completed: variant=v2-int8-fastpath, rollout=100%, 2024-11-04T03:21:00Z
Maya Support: Can you repro with our SDK and include sampling params? Are temperature/top_p tuned?
Ken (FinTrust): We used defaults via SDK: temperature 0.0, top_p 1.0. Repro command we ran:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat 
  -H "Authorization: Bearer ****" 
  -d '{"model":"v2-int8-fastpath","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Summarize FinTrust's regulatory history and any material restatements."}],"temperature":0.0}'
```
Ken (FinTrust): Response: model confidently invents filings and dates. This is high-severity for them — legal/compliance team flagged it.
Alice CS: Marking P1 for customer impact. @Raj Eng @Maya Support please triage. Suggest immediate routing override to pin them to a conservative variant until root cause identified. :eyes: :warning:
Raj Eng: Temporary mitigation: pin FinTrust to model "v2-std-precise" (no quantized fastpath) and disable prefix pruning for their route. I can push a route override, will need SRE approval for the change.
Maya Support: Ticket created FT-1234 and attached transcript. Also adding other customers who flagged similar behaviour in the last 48h.
Ken (FinTrust): Thank you — we'll validate after the pin. For investigation, I can provide a set of prompts where it invents citations.
Raj Eng: Please also include sampling seeds and full model logs (kv cache traces optional). We want to know whether the hallucination is correlated with quantization + pruning.
Alice CS: If we can't get this stabilized in 24h, we'll escalate to model-onboarding + legal for customer communications and open a postmortem.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated for customer route override: FinTrust -> v2-std-precise (temp). Change-id: chg-7742
Maya Support: Noted. Assigning follow-ups: @Raj Eng to investigate kernel/quantization interaction, @Maya Support to coordinate with FinTrust and collect repro corpus.
Ken (FinTrust): After pin, initial checks look better — responses stop asserting fake filings. We'll keep you updated.
Alice CS: Thanks team. Keep thread updated with any delta.
